verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for an invoicing SaaS, but nothing in the evidence pack documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for events. The only related items are adjacent: integrations with other Zoho apps, automated reminders and scheduled sending, and probes showing no OpenAPI spec and a 404 on the API docs page.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
